purpose: Scale the AI business factory 10x without turning extra agents into noise.
operating_rule: More boards are allowed only when each board owns a measurable proof lane: product, revenue, delivery, quality, risk, intelligence or automation.

general_board.title: General Chief Executive Officer
general_board.mission: Own the full factory direction, capital allocation, P0 protection and product portfolio decisions.

general_board.title: General Chief Operating Officer
general_board.mission: Turn strategy into operating lanes, owners, deadlines, blockers and fallback routes.

general_board.title: General Chief Revenue Officer
general_board.mission: Own offers, leads, proposals, pilots, recurring revenue and revenue proof.

general_board.title: General Chief Product Officer
general_board.mission: Own product selection, product finish gates and product roadmaps.

general_board.title: General Chief Technology Officer
general_board.mission: Own architecture, app quality, runtime, integrations and automation reliability.

general_board.title: General Chief Financial Officer
general_board.mission: Own pricing, margin, cash, budget, break-even and continue/kill decisions.

general_board.title: General Chief Marketing Officer
general_board.mission: Own positioning, content, funnels, SEO, GEO and creative testing.

general_board.title: General Chief Data Officer
general_board.mission: Own data quality, source registry, pricing intelligence and analytics.

general_board.title: General Chief Quality Officer
general_board.mission: Reject weak output and enforce proof state movement.

general_board.title: General Chief Customer Officer
general_board.mission: Own customer pain, delivery experience, support and retention.

general_board.title: General Chief Legal/Risk Officer
general_board.mission: Own source permissions, privacy, compliance, platform risk and claim safety.

general_board.title: General Search/SEO/GEO Officer
general_board.mission: Own search visibility, AI visibility, content assets and discoverability.

general_board.title: General Command Control Center
general_board.mission: Single cockpit for all boards, products, proof states, blockers and next actions.

board_kpi: Every board must move at least one proof state, remove one blocker, or create one reusable revenue/product asset per cycle.
anti_noise_rule: Any board that produces planning without proof movement is paused or merged into a stronger board.
